comments.body: I agree that looking along the major train lines (e.g., the IC trains of SBB) makes sense. In that regard, looking for a place in Schaffhausen may also be a good option, as you have bi-hourly connections of 39 min from Schaffhausen to Zürich HB that also run late in the night. Keep in mind that from some places just outside the city of Zürich, it also takes some 30 min to ETH Zentrum by Tram / bus…
comments.author: Bitter-Run-6205
